construction.implementation_origin: New implementation written for this isolated build

shared_schema.envelope: schema_version=1, synthetic=true, documents[], products[], profile, limit (integer 1..100)
shared_schema.document: Unique id, title, text, reliability [0,1], claims[]
shared_schema.claim: topic, value, stance support|oppose, confidence [0,1], exact quote substring of document.text; unique topic/value/stance per document
shared_schema.product: Unique id, name, attributes object mapping topics to nonblank string values
shared_schema.profile: preferences[] of unique topic/value/weight (0,1], exclude_product_ids[] referencing catalog IDs
shared_schema.research_stage: Original envelope plus status=researched and research {document_count, findings, disagreements, unresolved_questions, limitations}
shared_schema.completed_output: Research envelope with status=ok and recommendations[] {product_id, name, score, mode, reasons, unresolved_questions}
shared_schema.validation: One validate function used at every boundary; exact fields, types, finite numeric ranges, references, grounded quotes and duplicate checks. Derived stage outputs are recomputed for strict consistency; duplicate JSON keys and nonfinite literals are rejected.
shared_schema.error_output: Single JSON object with status=error and message; exit 2 for validation, JSON, encoding, usage and file errors

cross_stage_handoffs.contract: recommend receives only the validated research envelope, including profile and catalog. It uses research findings for evidence adjustments and forwards matched unresolved questions and source IDs.
cross_stage_handoffs.integrity: Research fields and citations must exactly match deterministic synthesis from validated source claims before ranking

behavior.research: Group exact topic/value pairs across documents; claim weight is source reliability times claim confidence. Aggregate support and opposition, preserve quotations and document IDs, report both-sided positive-weight disagreements and zero-weight uncertainty. Missing preference evidence produces unresolved questions.
behavior.personalization: For each matched preference: weight*(0.75+0.25*evidence_balance), otherwise zero; normalize by total preference weight. Evidence balance is (support-oppose)/(support+oppose), or zero when unknown. Scores measure heuristic fit, not probability. Preferences retain priority even when evidence is opposed.
behavior.cold_start: With no preferences, average positive evidence balance over catalog attributes; unknown attributes contribute zero. Empty attributes yield zero.
behavior.ordering: Descending score then ascending unique product ID, after explicit exclusions; limit applied last.
behavior.uncertainty: Disputed and missing evidence remains explicit in explanations rather than being presented as settled fact.
behavior.matching: Case-sensitive exact strings; no semantic inference or synonym normalization
behavior.side_effects: Input is deep-copied, no files are written by the pipeline, and the CLI prints exactly one JSON object

included: Grounded quotation validation and disagreement provenance
One integrated schema and validation layer
excluded: Live research, network access and model providers
LLM integration and unstructured claim extraction
Independent fact verification or source-dependence detection
Enterprise deployment, persistence and collaborative filtering
Semantic matching, numeric attributes and price constraints

test_outcomes.cli: passed: exit 0, one JSON object, status ok
test_outcomes.coverage: Both stages, disagreement and unresolved evidence, cross-stage provenance and score changes, tampered outputs, determinism, immutability, empty inputs, cold start, tie breaking, exclusions, limits, invalid schema and numeric values, CLI success, usage, missing files and malformed JSON
